senses.definition: n.pr.loc. Ακχω, Acco, in Asher, Ju 1:31, + Jos 19:30 (P), reading ע׳ for MT עֻמָּה, Di Kau Benn Ency. Bib., after 𝔊 Codd.; a seaport N. of Carmel (= Acre, Ptolemais), mod. ʿAkka, cf. BuhlGeogr. 228 (Egyptian ʿA-ka, ’Ακη WMMAs. u. Eur. 181; Assyrian Akkû, COTGloss, TelAm. Ak-ka).
